subject: Staging dependency causing pilot delay — request for runway relief and short-term credit
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@vectorops.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Chen <victor.chen@vectorops.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot hold — staging SDK regression + request for runway relief

Hi Mateo,

Quick note from our side — we hit an unexpected regression in the VectorOps SDK (auth handshake) when attempting to deploy the final staging build this morning. Our platform team investigated and flagged a deeper dependency mismatch in the adapter layer; the engineer estimate to fix, test, and validate in staging is roughly 10 working days (we're working in a staggered release cadence). That pushes our demo and pilot milestones out and we will likely miss the current contract timeline.

We really like Redwood and want to keep the pilot moving, but we need two things to avoid losing momentum: an official trial extension for ~2 weeks beyond the pilot end date, and a small runway credit (sandbox/top-up) to cover extra token usage while we re-run test suites. Are those options you can approve at your end? I can share the error logs and a short timeline from engineering (attaching the log and a screenshot).

Attaching: integration-log.txt, staging-error-screenshot.png

Thanks — Sara

--
Sara Lim
Director, Engineering
VectorOps
Sara.Lim@vectorops.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@vectorops.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — staging SDK regression + request for runway relief

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick heads up and for the logs. Sorry you ran into that; SDK/integration regressions are unfortunately common when adapters are versioned across CI pipelines.

Two immediate items from our side:
- Can you confirm the current pilot end date you’d like extended to (we can do 14 or 21 days; tell us what fits your rollout window).
- Do you need a token top-up only to re-run tests, or would you prefer a short sandbox credit + extended window?

I’ve looped in Priyom (account lead) and Dev (integration engineer) so we can craft an approval and scoped mutual action plan. High-level: we can approve a temporary runway extension and a one-time sandbox credit under a limited "make-good" program, but I need Priyom to confirm amounts and any internal approvals.

If you can provide an ETA for the patch and the key CI job names that will consume tokens, that’ll help us size the credit.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0214

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@vectorops.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — staging SDK regression + request for runway relief

Hi all — reviewed Sara's attachments and the Jira ticket VEC-358 linked in the logs. Dev, can you confirm the estimate? If it's ~10 business days and the work is scoped to a single adapter, we can offer the following under the pilot make-good playbook:

- 14 calendar day pilot extension from the current end date (no change to per-token billing during the extension)
- One-time sandbox credit of 100,000 tokens to cover test re-runs and staged smoke tests
- A lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) to record scope, owners, and verification steps — Mateo, can you share our MAP template?

Internal note: procurement/legal do not need a contract amendment for credits < $5k; we should confirm with finance but this fits the small top-up threshold.

Dev (cc'd) — please confirm the 10-day ETA and whether there are any upstream infra changes we need to be aware of that could increase the token consumption estimate.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@vectorops.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Chen <victor.chen@vectorops.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — staging SDK regression + request for runway relief

Thanks Priyom — that plan sounds reasonable and appreciated. Confirming: 14 days should be enough if our engineers can push a fix within 10 business days. We accept the 100k token sandbox credit.

A few quick asks before we close this out:
- Can you share the MAP template so we can align engineers and attach it to our Jira ticket?
- Will this extension affect our pilot pricing or any metrics used in the POC evaluation? We want to ensure the evaluation window is preserved (i.e., we shouldn't be penalized for the delay).

We will attach a short internal timeline and the CI job names in the next update. Thanks for fast turnaround on this — will help keep the internal stakeholders calm.

– Sara

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@vectorops.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, VectorOps Procurement <procurement@vectorops.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot hold — staging SDK regression + request for runway relief

Sara — great, glad that works. Confirming the agreed items:

1) Pilot extension: +14 calendar days from your original pilot end date (please confirm the original end date in reply if different from what we have in HubSpot).
2) Sandbox credit: one-time 100,000 tokens applied to your sandbox environment (no automatic extension of production billing).

Next steps:
- I attached our MAP template (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) to this thread and added a shared MAP spreadsheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MAP-VectorOps. Please populate owners and the verification checklist.
- I've opened an internal ticket to provision the credit; finance will post the credit entry against deal RV-2026-4721 and it should reflect in your portal within 24 hours.
- For a formal record, we can do a short contract amendment/DocuSign for the extension if Procurement prefers. If not required, this email thread plus HubSpot note will suffice.

Related: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4721; Jira: https://vectortickets.atlassian.net/browse/VEC-358

Attaching: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MAP template)

If Procurement needs a DocuSign link, we can initiate that today — otherwise I'll proceed to provision the credit.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
